attributes.name: title
attributes.content: Inclusive Hiring Training | Rochester Institute of Technology

attributes.name: description
attributes.content: Looking to conduct a hire? Consider this volunteer training to learn ways to minimize bias and reduce discrimination within the hiring process. The training is best served for Assistant Director or higher staff positions and all faculty positions. Choose the training date and time that works best for your schedule. You only need to complete one. If interested, register via Workday.
